design_note: GRAVE V14 localized visor/chin revision. Front starts at just forward of V13 roof apex (y=+0.035 vs +0.082), unified ivory visor, no dark central stripe and no independent center mesh forward of seam. Rear stripe retained. Chin follows component blueprint 07: forked upper tips, recessed center, sharply tapered flat-ended trapezoid, chamfered light gray alloy with rear mounting depth; dimensions visually interpreted, not CAD. Unrelated components preserved exactly. 51 local-origin modules, input closure/area/volume checks on replacement meshes, existing modular exports and attachment audit. No image generation, no game integration.

module_exports.source: Generated component blueprint; approximate proportions, not calibrated CAD.
